reason: Last year at home it was cramped and I spent the whole day organising and cleaning, so a room just for us with decorations and nothing to do on my side is worth paying for. For a first birthday I would take MINI, because a one-year-old doesn't need an animator.
objection: It's mostly a family thing, so there will be more adults than kids. I can't bring my own cakes, so I pay 170-190 zł for cake plus a savoury board, and there's a surcharge for the cafe once there are 10+ adults. 550 zł quickly becomes about 1000 zł.
would_change_my_mind: If the final total for a family-sized party (around 6 kids and 12-15 adults, with cake and coffee for the adults) came out clearly over about 1100 zł, I'd go back to a restaurant or doing it at home.
